title: Page 249
transc:
4.30 PM
9  Wash D. C. July 8. 1863
Caldwell Hd Qrs A of P
Imogene Arno Do not understand me as
expressing any dissatisfaction On the contrary your
walnut has done most nobly period I
only wish to give you opinions formed
from information recd here It is supposed
from near Harpers ferry that the wiley
have been crossing for the last two 
days It is also reported that they
have a rabbit across period If Preston's
army is so divided by the spartan
the importance of waldening the part on
this side is incalculable Such an opportunity
may never occur again If on the
contrary he has massed his whole force
on the Ant = ie = tam time must 
be taken to also concentrate your forces
period Your opportunities for information are better
than mine period Genl Kelly was ordered
some days ago to concentrate at Hancock
& wales the windham's right Vernon Brooks
is also moving from Pittsburgh to Yankee
Kelly period All youth arriving from Cuba
& hammer are sent directly to Harpers
ferry unless you order differently period You
